stories.title: Quaest: Ciro Gomes tem 43% e Elmano de Freitas, 41%, no Ceará

en.title: Quaest: Ciro Gomes has 43% and Elmano de Freitas, 41%, in Ceará
en.summary: A Quaest poll shows former governor Ciro Gomes leading numerically at 43% of voting intentions versus incumbent governor Elmano de Freitas at 41% in the race for Ceará's government, representing a technical tie.

stories.title: Disputa entre Ciro e Elmano tem polarização, ataques e palanques múltiplos no Ceará

en.title: Dispute between Ciro and Elmano features polarization, attacks and multiple campaign platforms in Ceará
en.summary: The gubernatorial race in Ceará between Ciro Gomes and Elmano de Freitas is marked by polarization, intense attacks, and multiple campaign events, including a gathering in Fortaleza organized by federal deputy André Fernandes.

stories.title: A 11 dias do 1º turno, Flávio Bolsonaro e aliados fazem ofensiva por voto útil

en.title: Eleven days before the first round, Flávio Bolsonaro and allies mount offensive for strategic voting
en.summary: With eleven days remaining before the first electoral round, Flávio Bolsonaro and his political allies are conducting a campaign focused on promoting strategic voting.

stories.title: Quaest no Ceará: Lula, 55%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 23%; Augusto Cury, 5%; Renan Santos, 3%; Ronaldo Caiado, 1%

en.title: Quaest in Ceará: Lula, 55%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 23%; Augusto Cury, 5%; Renan Santos, 3%; Ronaldo Caiado, 1%
en.summary: A Quaest poll conducted among Ceará voters shows Lula leading at 55% in the first round presidential race, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro at 23%, Augusto Cury at 5%, Renan Santos at 3%, and Ronaldo Caiado at 1%.

stories.title: Quaest no Ceará: 56% aprovam e 36% desaprovam governo de Elmano de Freitas

en.title: Quaest in Ceará: 56% approve and 36% disapprove Elmano de Freitas government
en.summary: A Quaest poll shows that 56% of respondents approve of Ceará state governor Elmano de Freitas's administration, while 36% disapprove. The survey also found that 39% rate the government positively overall.

stories.title: Alexandre Pires foi beneficiado em lavagem de US$ 50 mi envolvendo garimpo na Yanomami, suspeita PF

en.title: Alexandre Pires was benefited in US$ 50 million money laundering involving illegal mining in Yanomami, suspects Federal Police
en.summary: Brazil's Federal Police suspects that singer Alexandre Pires's company received 2.5 million reais from a scheme laundering approximately 50 million US dollars connected to illegal cassiterite mining in the Yanomami Indigenous territory.

stories.title: Quaest no Ceará: Ciro Gomes, 43%; Elmano de Freitas, 41%

en.title: Quaest in Ceará: Ciro Gomes, 43%; Elmano de Freitas, 41%
en.summary: A Quaest poll for Ceará's 2026 gubernatorial election shows Ciro Gomes with 43% voter support and incumbent Elmano de Freitas with 41%, placing them in a technical tie.

stories.title: Corpo de dentista achado morto após sair para entregar prótese será velado e sepultado em Itu

en.title: Body of dentist found dead after leaving to deliver denture will be waked and buried in Itu
en.summary: The body of 37-year-old dentist Christian Eduardo Corsi, discovered Tuesday showing signs of violence near a wooded area, was waked and buried Wednesday in Itu after he went missing four days earlier.

stories.title: Presidente iraniano diz na ONU que jamais se ajoelhará e acusa EUA e Israel de terrorismo

en.title: Iranian president says at UN he will never kneel and accuses US and Israel of terrorism
en.summary: Iran's president made statements at the United Nations rejecting submission and characterizing the United States and Israel as terrorist entities.

stories.title: Alexandre Pires é alvo de operação da PF que investiga garimpo ilegal na Terra Indígena Yanomami

en.title: Alexandre Pires is target of federal police operation investigating illegal mining in Yanomami Indigenous land
en.summary: Brazil's federal police launched an operation targeting Alexandre Pires in connection with illegal mining activities occurring on Yanomami Indigenous territory.

stories.title: Corpo do cantor Rick será velado e enterrado em Sorocaba, interior de São Paulo

en.title: Singer Rick's body will be waked and buried in Sorocaba, interior of São Paulo
en.summary: The body of singer Rick will undergo a wake and funeral service in the city of Sorocaba in São Paulo state's interior region.

stories.title: Sem Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro, Record decide cancelar debate presidencial do 1º turno

en.title: Without Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, Record decides to cancel first-round presidential debate
en.summary: The Record television network canceled its first-round presidential debate scheduled for the following Sunday due to absences of key candidates, maintaining normal programming instead.

stories.title: Estoques de petróleo dos EUA contrariam estimativa e sobem na semana passada

en.title: US oil inventories rise last week, contrary to estimates
en.summary: US crude oil inventories increased by 2.969 million barrels in the week ending Friday the 18th, according to the Department of Energy, defying economist expectations of a 500,000 barrel decline. Gasoline inventories fell 1.686 million barrels while distillate reserves were also affected.

stories.title: Governo abre consulta pública para definir política de seguros em concessões de aeroportos, hidrovias e portos

en.title: Government opens public consultation to define insurance policy for airport, waterway and port concessions
en.summary: Brazil's government launched a 30-day public consultation to establish insurance policy guidelines for private sector concessions and operations of airport, waterway and port infrastructure. The process will include risk mapping criteria and security assessment standards for viability studies.

stories.title: Na ONU, Presidente do Paraguai defende retorno da Venezuela ao Mercosul

en.title: At the UN, Paraguay's President defends Venezuela's return to Mercosur
en.summary: Paraguay's president Santiago Peña advocated for Venezuela's reintegration into Mercosur during remarks to world leaders at the UN General Assembly. Venezuela has been indefinitely suspended from the South American trade bloc.

stories.title: Alckmin sanciona lei que endurece penas para furto e roubo de combustíveis

en.title: Alckmin sanctions law that increases penalties for fuel theft and robbery
en.summary: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, acting as President, signed legislation increasing criminal penalties for theft and robbery of petroleum, derivatives, and fuels. The new law modifies the Penal Code to cover crude oil, natural gas, ethanol, and other fluid fuels including biofuels and lubricating oils.

stories.title: Mercadante critica atuação de BC e CVM: ‘Fiscalização e regulação estão muito fragilizadas’

en.title: Mercadante criticizes Central Bank and CVM performance: 'Oversight and regulation are very weakened'
en.summary: The BNDES president stated that supervision and regulation by Brazil's Central Bank and securities commission are weakened, emphasizing the need to strengthen these bodies to prevent fraud and financial crimes.
